summary: A product page for the firm's own dashboards (5,500px): a head with an animated visual, a radial pain-point diagram, ten benefit cards, a two-tab 'for firms / for clients' block, a split with a screenshot and four points, and a purple closing band with a demo form.

sections.note: pale beige ground with stepped corner shapes; centered title, one-line lead, one coral button and a large animated visual (lazy, blank in a still shot) below it.
centered heading and line; a ring diagram: six round icon badges (cog in the centre) with a bold title and a line each, around a centre mark
pale blue: centered heading; ten white cards in two columns, each a coral line icon, a bold title and one line
heading; two tab buttons (for firms, for firm clients) over a lilac panel with a bold line and five ticked points in two columns
heading; a rounded screenshot of a dashboard left, four icon bullets (title and line) right
purple band: heading and portrait with contact lines left, a white demo form card right
